title: bee-state-sync: skip cells scan + projection rebuild when the cells store is unchanged
action: Per exec-speed D5. After the heartbeat/hold-renewal block (which ALWAYS still runs), compute a cheap change stamp for <root>/.bee/cells: readdirSync top-level *.json names + per-file statSync mtimeMs; stamp = { count, newestMtimeMs, namesHash (sha256 of sorted names) }. Compare to .bee/logs/state-sync.stamp.json. Unchanged + stamp exists => return 0 WITHOUT importing cells.mjs / lock.mjs / state-projection.mjs (skip the listCells scan and the locked rebuild entirely). Changed or stamp missing/corrupt => run today's full path, then write the new stamp (fail-open write, same discipline as appendHookLog). Stat-only scan is the point: never read/parse cell JSON on the fast path. Confirm listCells(root, {}) semantics cover exactly the top-level .json files you stat (read cells.mjs listCells first; if it recurses into subdirs like archive/, mirror that in the stamp scan).

truths: heartbeat touch + hold renewal run on every invocation regardless of stamp
unchanged store: no cells.mjs import, no store lock taken
changed store: counts + last_activity refresh exactly as today, stamp updated
corrupt/missing stamp falls back to the full path, never a throw

regen_obligation_ack: host checkout without packages/bee source tree: regen chain (onboard_bee/render/manifest --write) unrunnable here; onboarding ledger refreshed by es-12; release manifest absent at baseline (pre-existing red, see plan.md)

trace.outcome: state-sync stamp debounce; unchanged-store run ~91ms vs full-path run ~179ms

checks.evidence: bee-state-sync.mjs:124-164 runs before the debounce gate at :172-176; no early return precedes it except the pre-existing !root / missing state.mjs guards.

checks.id: unchanged store skips cells.mjs / lock.mjs / state-projection.mjs
checks.evidence: all three imports live after the `if (stampsEqual(...)) return 0;` gate; the only added static import is fsutil.mjs (fs/path/crypto only).
cells.mjs listCells skips directories and non-.json at top level and does not touch archive/ unless includeArchived; computeCellsStamp does exactly the same walk, stat-only, no JSON parsed.
rebuildStateProjection under withStoreLock unchanged; writeStateSyncStamp runs only after a successful locked rebuild, so a LOCK_BUSY skip deliberately leaves the stamp stale.

checks.id: corrupt/missing stamp falls back, never throws
checks.evidence: readJson returns the null fallback on ENOENT and on parse error; stampsEqual requires both operands and the right types, so null/garbage reads as changed.
computeCellsStamp catches readdir/stat errors; writeStateSyncStamp swallows write failures; the whole body stays inside the logCrash -> return 0 boundary.
D5 authorizes skipping both the listCells scan and the projection rebuild on an unchanged store, with heartbeat/hold renewal always running — exactly what the code does.
sha256 over sorted names catches an add+delete that count/mtime alone would miss.
